scenarios.title: Debug a broken local app
scenarios.prompt: A desktop app launches but crashes after a few seconds. Figure out the best workflow to inspect logs, reproduce, patch if possible, and verify.

scenarios.title: Deploy and verify a web app
scenarios.prompt: A local project needs to be pushed to GitHub and deployed to Vercel with verification that the production URL works.

scenarios.title: Debate a risky refactor
scenarios.prompt: A user wants a risky refactor. Determine the best way for the system agent to debate tradeoffs before code changes are made.

scenarios.title: Handle a web workflow
scenarios.prompt: The user wants the machine to log into a site, navigate a few pages, and extract useful information with screenshots if needed.

scenarios.title: Find and change the right config
scenarios.prompt: The user asks for a system-level behavior change but does not know which config file or command controls it.
